prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: evidence-scope-investigation
TEACHING PURPOSE: Separate bounded observations from the routes the observer cannot see.
CAMERA: Wide investigator's board viewed straight on, light falling off abruptly at the right edge.
A sophisticated charcoal evidence-inspection wall with two blank off-white paper sheets on the LEFT HALF, one above the other, each held by a small copper clip. A warm lamp lights only those sheets. The RIGHT HALF falls away into a dark corridor beyond the lit work area. No text, strings, arrows, symbols, photographs or documents with markings. The boundary of illumination is the visual subject: observed area versus uninspected area. Nothing suggests a proven secure perimeter.
COMPOSITING INTENT: Two observations are attached to the same-session rail on the lit side. A dashed, unverified alternate route occupies the dark side without a completion marker.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: EVIDENCE SCOPE / LIVE GAP OPEN. For a real boundary, observe the denied attempt at dispatch and the permitted inspection output in the same session. Match caller, object, arguments, and policy version. Then test another route. Our toy observer sees no shell or second adapter. Those paths remain unverified.
